answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed dune vouching only for itself, unable to send real edges across the delta. Honest identities gather many independent vouches, steady as the tide; a ring has only its own, so the counting rule starves it however large it grows.
